subject: social
changelog: v1 Phase 1: chapter list only. Chapter ids/titles = the question bank's (textbook-verified in R1); chapter page ranges from the mechanical structure pass, all 147 chapter starts aligned to bank titles. Sections come in Phase 2 (map v2). v1.1: subject divisions added from the textbook contents pages (coordinator-read, 2026-10-11). | v2 Phase 2 (spine2-class-10-social, 2026-10-20): per-chapter `sections` added = reviewed list of main sections (standalone printed bold headings), curated against the page images from the mechanical draft soc-10-2026_sections_draft_v1.json. Run-in sub-heads, figure/table/map captions and labels, Know-this boxes, exercise blocks, numbered list items and generic list-labels dropped (see curation_notes per chapter). Page ranges: pdf_page_start=heading page; pdf_page_end=next kept section heading page (same-page overlap allowed) / last content page for the final section. H0 = non-tickable intro pseudo-section.

field_semantics.selection_unit: chapter (Phase 1). Every bank question already carries chapter_id; no question-side change needed.
field_semantics.board_relevance: Class 10 only: chapter-level placeholder; in Phase 2 the sections hit by MQP questions get board_relevance high (Yash 2026-10-09).
field_semantics.mqp_priority: Class 10 MQP records (units soc-10-91..94, section mqp) are board_priority + repeatable for the generator; other classes have no priority tier.
field_semantics.subject_division: division = the subject grouping printed on the textbook contents page (History / Civics or Political Science / Sociology / Geography / Economics / Business Studies), verbatim per class; `divisions` lists them in contents order for the QP module UI.
